test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/645913bcc1c0dc4b04a762f107410f501291a57f2a85a77a4804be57486d5173.png]
solution:
The images in the figure are shifting its position by rotating in:

1. Left corner figure present in first row moves to the third figure which is present diagonally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f103d7d02482c82088f57fbb30b25be2fc086e111f42d4f6fcf26d549acfce6.png] 

2. Third figure(placed diagonally) moves to left corner figure which is present in the last row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65b3a87d6a8e6e7d5a9f1e96dfe93b174fa0f81758f6fc2edc4abce4749b51c7.png] 

3. Right corner figure(Last row) moves to right corner figure(first row). For Example in this figure the square [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86fd148d2e63528bdb03a9febdcd87257cffb7818d12e2f56abb79e662bda614.png] moves to the place of Triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe1d5239680ec76696cfd2c6a528a172b94059f2263ccbbfe199a0c019dc19b.png] 

4. Left corner figure(last row) moves up and disappears and New figure appears on the left corner (first row).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e6da47f5d7c0b0466d2582506ae6857d6f52957cb23e88b7fcc5889772200b.png] 

5. Right corner figure(first row) moves diagonally down and disappears. New figure comes at second position(diagonally).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3643a85d95bb01e140799a60a77d5e92d5e25758d67f03c95d8a0b5d81211270.png] 

6. Second figure(diagonally) moves to the fourth figure place(diagonally). For example [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86fd148d2e63528bdb03a9febdcd87257cffb7818d12e2f56abb79e662bda614.png] moves to the place of [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/411c9083ceb656fac295754c41ef185321e7062584a897a7b7e35632adbf0d96.png] .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/767ef3e5a3c6a102f5a1ba40e3609bcd205fc239aa73b4ab44694e1b178e42de.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (2)".**
